blocks.text: CITY OF SAN FERNANDO, Pampanga — Councilor Racquel “Kay” Pineda of this capital city, along with officers and representatives of her Kay-Land Real Estate Development Corp., is facing estafa and syndicate estafa complaints. That is after she and two others were entrapped by authorities last Friday (Nov. 13) for alleged fraudulent sale and collection related to residential lots, several of which were in the name of state agencies. Criminal Investigation and Detection Group operatives entrapped Pineda, Rebecca Cala and Analyn Pascual in Kay-Land’s office in Barangay San Agustin.
